address: 16 Lancao Road, Wuhou, Chengdu, China Mainland
bio: It doesn't take a rocket scientist to figure out the eponymous specialities of the house. Dumplings are freshly made daily in the open kitchen and varieties are served each day, each to be ordered in units of 5. Those filled with pork and mushrooms, or beef and Chinese celery are the highlights. Nestled in a quiet neighbourhood, the cosy room features a clean and modern décor with a light wood and dark green colour scheme....
